_comment: HaptiX internal research representation of frequency-calibrated haptic stimuli. NOT an official Android OS JSON format.
source: AOSP Haptics Architecture Guidelines & Pacinian Corpuscle Psychophysics (Choi & Kuchenbecker, 2013)
description: Research-calibrated vibrotactile stimulus sequence for multimodal audiovisual evaluation. The stimulus frequencies (150, 180, 200, 235, 250 Hz) are experimental test values selected by HaptiX to span the human Pacinian mechanoreceptor sensitivity curve (~150-250 Hz). These are NOT universal Android actuator resonant frequencies; actuator resonant frequency (f0) is strictly device-dependent and must be queried from Android's hardware APIs (Vibrator.getResonantFrequency / Vibrator.getFrequencyProfile) where supported.

points.description: Lower test stimulus pulse (150 Hz) representing the lower boundary of human Pacinian sensitivity
points.provenance: perception-literature motivated & experimentally selected by HaptiX

points.description: Intermediate experimental test pulse (180 Hz) within the lower-mid tactile band
Peak human tactile sensitivity stimulus (200 Hz, Pacinian corpuscle optimal threshold region)
Upper-band experimental test pulse (235 Hz); device-specific actuator resonance must be obtained via Android APIs
Tactile test pulse at 250 Hz benchmark (established optimal displacement threshold in human psychophysics)
